# Town of Ripton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Ripton, 2025 Town Report: the signed 2026 warning (floor meeting March 2, 2026; Australian ballot March 3, 2026, Article 9) and the Elected and Appointed Town Officers tables: Tim O'Leary, Moderator; Article 9 elects a Selector (three years), a Moderator (one year), a Delinquent Tax Collector (one year), a Lister (three years), a Cemetery Commissioner (five years), and a Constable (one year); no auditor, grand juror, town agent, or trustee of public funds stands. The 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk unless the town has voted to authorize appointment under 17 V.S.A. section 2651e

Town of Ripton, 2025 Town Report: the signed 2026 warning (floor meeting March 2, 2026; Australian ballot March 3, 2026, Article 9) and the Elected and Appointed Town Officers tables: the officers tables place Alison Joseph Dickinson in the Appointed table ('Town Admin/Clerk'), not the Elected table, and the office did not stand on the 2026 ballot; she serves as Town Clerk by appointment. The conversion instrument was not located (disclosed)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Alison Joseph Dickinson as Ripton's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer unless the town has voted to authorize appointment under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f
Town of Ripton, Treasurer page (riptonvermont.org): the treasurer has been appointed by the Selectboard since 2018; Carolyn Smith is the Town Treasurer

Town of Ripton, 2025 Town Report: the signed 2026 warning (floor meeting March 2, 2026; Australian ballot March 3, 2026, Article 9) and the Elected and Appointed Town Officers tables: Carolyn Smith appears in the Appointed officers table as Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Ripton's three selectboard members: Giles Hoyler, William Hunsinger, and 'H Wilcox' (the directory truncates her given name)
Town of Ripton, Selectboard page (riptonvermont.org): Giles Hoyler (Chair), Bill Hunsinger, and Brooke Wilcox; Laureen 'Laurie' Cox retired at the 2026 meeting after 40 years

Town of Ripton, Cemetery Commission page (riptonvermont.org): the commission is five: Elizabeth Walker (Co-Chair, to 2027), Samantha Smith (2028), Bonnie Swan (2029), and Karen Heppell (Co-Chair, to 2030), with the seat ending in 2026 unfilled

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Ripton Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Ripton justices of the peace: Alexander Cox, Jenna Hunsinger, Richard Kim Kimler, Amy McGlashan, and Norm Tjossem. McGlashan vacated the seat in 2025 (see the election note); Irene Poole was appointed in her place and holds an appointed membership with no candidacy

jp_election.name: Town of Ripton Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names five winners for Ripton's five justice of the peace seats; one winner, Amy McGlashan, vacated the seat in 2025 and is not recorded (the 2025 Town Report's justice list shows Irene Poole 'appointed 2025' in her place); the winners list holds the four surviving elected justices while vote_for stays at the slate size, per the Enosburgh/Maidstone/Pomfret pattern

Town of Ripton, 2025 Town Report: the signed 2026 warning (floor meeting March 2, 2026; Australian ballot March 3, 2026, Article 9) and the Elected and Appointed Town Officers tables: the report's justice of the peace list shows Irene Poole appointed in 2025 and does not list McGlashan
